$comment: Copy to claw.json at the Claw root and edit. claw.json is gitignored (it names your private repos).

schedules.name: Watch Claw repo
schedules.prompt: Watchdog run for this repository. Check for: new/updated issues, new/updated PRs, CI failures, and commits since the timestamp recorded in the last verdict memory. Delegate inspection to worker sub-tasks, then save a compact verdict with memory_save including a pointer (timestamp/commit) the next run needs.
